paragraphs: R. Chiyya bar Lulyano, in Seder Taaniyot, 25a, where he brought down rain. Bava Batra 80b has Lulyani. In R. Hoshaya's name: Jerusalem Avodah Zarah, beginning of chapter 2. And R. Yosi son of R. Bun, in R. Shammai's name: Jerusalem Nazir, chapter 4, halakhah 4. At the beginning of chapter 2 of Orlah: bar Luliva said to R. Chananyah.
